name: Awakened
description: You were once ordinary until a single, overwhelming sexual experience permanently transformed you.
equipment: Clothing that feels especially good against hypersensitive skin
Small keepsake from the being or event that awakened you

traits: Ordinary sensations feel dull compared to what I now experience.
I am terrified of the being that awoke my sexuality.
I am both fascinated and frightened by my new sensitivity.
I enjoy losing myself completely in the intensity of pleasure.
I want to give others at least a fraction of the otherworldly pleasure I experienced.
My body reacts strongly to stimulation, and I can't hide it.
My awakening is both a gift and a curse.
I constantly yearn for touch, but I fear how deeply it affects me.

ideals.text: Discovery. I've become something different and I must find out what.
Sensation. Life is best lived seeking deeper and more complete sensations.
Control. I must master what I've become before it masters me.
Sharing. Everyone should experience what I've experienced.
Power. This awakening must be harnessed to elevate me above other mortals.
Acceptance. I must embrace who I am now, no matter the cost.

bonds: I am haunted by the entity that awakened me.
I need to find others that experienced what I did.
I must hide my sexual nature for fear of what people may think.
I owe a debt to the person or people that witnessed my awakening.
I want nothing more than to recreate my awakening moment.
I worry that I am no longer fully mortal.
flaws: I tend to lose sense of reality when experiencing even basic sensations.
I push my body too far just for the sensations.
I am addicted to intense pleasure and will always be chasing the next "high."
I feel that normal lovers are insufficient for me.
I will let the intensity of my pleasure kill me.
I won't let anybody see my true nature.
